meta.dataset: NEET UG cutoff ranks and score-to-AIR planning table
meta.quotaNotes: MCC Round 1 2026 and open-source 2025 AIQ ranks are NEET AIR. Chhattisgarh OR-CR ranks are state merit ranks and are explicitly labeled; they must not be compared with AIR. The linked open-source NEET cutoff file contains 2025 data; 2026 MCC records are official Round 1 allotments.
meta.scoreAirNotice: NTA does not publish a complete marks-to-AIR lookup table. Integer scores are interpolated from published result-analysis score bands; this is a 2025 reference, not a 2026 prediction.
meta.privacy: MCC candidate result rows are reduced to grouped institution/course/category rank intervals. No names, application numbers, or roll numbers are serialized.
